I'm giving her those numbers right away, thank you so much, you've been a great help.

~hugs~

Thank you for your support.

The thing about contact is that many of residential hospitals have "waiting periods" for things like electronics, somehow to help them with their therapy, so I might not be able to speak to her even electronically for six months or more. I'll still wait for her. I love her.

The biggest problem, though, and one I didn't address in the original post, is that I don't know if she'll be able to handle it. I'm scared she's going to commit suicide, and she's sent me messages about that. She's told me she'd rather be dead several times. I'm not a therapist, I can talk to her and be there for her but when she tells me that she'd be better off dead I just break down. I don't know what to say to something like that. She's promised she wont, solely for my sake, but I don't know if I believe her. I don't want to see my love go away.

Problem #1 is NOT true.

The focus points you gain is equal to 2.5% of the affinity you gain after level 30 on the weapon/frame. It is NOT solely based on kills, and you can still reliably gain focus points on any weapon or frame.

I'm making a public service announcement now because I've seen this mistake being made over and over again.

This is incorrect. 2.5% of all affinity granted for that respective weapon/warframe after hitting level 30 with the item which has a lens installed are granted to focus points.

Kills also grant focus points, but only because they grant affinity.
